name: Ryuto Sakuma
bio: Ryūto Sakuma (作間龍斗) was born on September 30, 2002. He is a member of Johnny's Jr. and is currently a member of the unit HiHi Jets.

credits.title: Leviathan
credits.overview: In a drifting spaceship running out of oxygen. When the students on board discover that the life-support system can sustain only one person, all 38 of them are thrown into a deadly survival game.

credits.title: A Bouquet of Light for You
credits.overview: Shoko Someya feels ordinary and struggles to see what makes her special. Mahiru Suzuki, her popular classmate and a rising idol, seems to have everything figured out. When the two become library committee members, Shoko discovers a side of Mahiru that he has kept hidden from everyone else.

credits.title: My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999
credits.overview: Akane Kinoshita is a university student, who was recently dumped by her ex-boyfriend. She is still heart broken by the rejection. She meets high school student & professional gamer Akito Yamada through an online game. At first, she thinks he is blunt and cold to people, but he sometimes shows his gentler side with her,

credits.title: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers
credits.overview: Ito is a second-year high school student and an only child who has to move to a different city; her mother remarried and begins her new life as an older sister of 4 siblings! The start of a family-love-comedy with four step-brothers!

credits.title: The Village
credits.overview: In a once-scenic village now dominated by a vast trash disposal site, a young man yearns to break free from a cruel fate tying him to the very grounds.

credits.title: Unlock Your Heart
credits.overview: Ai has had a crush forever on her classmate Tatoe. When she finds out that Tatoe is in a secret relationship with another girl, she sets out to sabotage their plans for the future.
